description: Stamp a page number on each page. In tagged PDFs the stamp is wrapped as an Artifact, preserving PDF/UA conformance. Formats containing CJK text need fontPath or the PDF_WRITER_FONT environment variable.

allowBreakingSignatures.description: When the target is digitally signed (detected via /ByteRange), the default is an error. Set true to proceed, accepting that the signatures become invalid.

fontPath.description: Font to embed (.ttf/.otf). Falls back to the PDF_WRITER_FONT environment variable, then the standard font. Required for formats containing CJK text.

format.description: Format. {n} = current page, {total} = total pages. Default "{n}". Examples: "- {n} -" / "{n} / {total}" / "Page {n}". Must contain {n}.

inputPath.description: Absolute path of the target PDF.

margin.description: Margin from the edge (pt). Default 24. Range 0-300.

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

pages.description: Pages to stamp, "1,3-5,8-" (1-based). All when omitted. Use "2-" to skip a cover page.

position.description: Placement. Default bottom-center. Visual position, taking page /Rotate into account.

preserveSignatures.description: Edit a signed PDF via an incremental update (appending) without invalidating existing signatures. Default false. The original bytes are untouched, so /ByteRange holds. Changes beyond the certification (DocMDP) permission level are refused.

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

startAt.description: First number to stamp. Default 1. Useful to start at 1 after skipping a cover page.

name: stamp_page_numbers
title: Stamp Page Numbers
